title: 冲突标记解析器：ours / theirs / base 三段抽取与 rerere
expected_output:
=== 1) 默认风格（merge.conflictStyle=merge）解析 ===
  ours 标签   : HEAD
  theirs 标签 : feature
  HEAD 段     : ['retries = 5']
  feature 段  : ['retries = 9']
  base 段     : []（默认风格没有，可用 merge.conflictStyle=diff3 打开）
  冲突段数: 1

=== 2) diff3 风格（含 ||||||| 共同祖先段）解析 ===
  base 段     : ['retries = 3']
  HEAD 段     : ['retries = 5']
  feature 段  : ['retries = 9']
  三方信息齐备: True

=== 3) 选择语义：git checkout --ours / --theirs / union / 人工解决 ===
  ours    -> ['timeout = 30', 'retries = 5', 'mode = safe']
  theirs  -> ['timeout = 30', 'retries = 9', 'mode = safe']
  union   -> ['timeout = 30', 'retries = 5', 'retries = 9', 'mode = safe']
  manual  -> ['timeout = 30', 'retries = 7', 'mode = safe']
  说明: union 把两侧行都留下（可能重复），--ours/--theirs 整段丢弃另一侧，都不等于『正确解决』

=== 4) rerere（reuse recorded resolution）回放 ===
  第一次解决后记录: id=7d50322 -> ['retries = 7']
  再次遇到同一冲突时命中缓存: True
  自动套用的解决结果: ['retries = 7']
  提示: rerere 需 git config rerere.enabled true，缓存位于 .git/rr-cache/
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""冲突文件里 Git 写入的标记 <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>（diff3 风格还有 ||||||| base 段）。
本例实现解析器 + git checkout --ours/--theirs 的选择语义 + rerere 回放。"""
BASE_STYLE = """timeout = 30
<<<<<<< HEAD
retries = 5
=======
retries = 9
>>>>>>> feature
mode = safe
"""

DIFF3_STYLE = """timeout = 30
<<<<<<< HEAD
retries = 5
||||||| merged common ancestors
retries = 3
=======
retries = 9
>>>>>>> feature
mode = safe
"""


def parse_conflicts(text):
    """返回 [(before, base_seg, ours_seg, theirs_seg, ours_label, theirs_label)] 风格的区段列表。"""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    segments, plain, i = [], [], 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.startswith("<<<<<<<"):
            ours_label = line[len("<<<<<<<"):].strip()
            ours, theirs, base_seg, end = [], [], [], None
            j = i + 1
            mode = "ours"
            while j < len(lines):
                cur = lines[j]
                if cur.startswith("|||||||"):
                    mode = "base"
                    end = cur
                elif cur.startswith("======="):
                    mode = "theirs"
                    end = cur
                elif cur.startswith(">>>>>>>"):
                    theirs_label = cur[len(">>>>>>>"):].strip()
                    break
                elif mode == "ours":
                    ours.append(cur)
                elif mode == "base":
                    base_seg.append(cur)
                else:
                    theirs.append(cur)
                j += 1
            segments.append({
                "before": plain,
                "ours_label": ours_label,
                "theirs_label": theirs_label,
                "base": base_seg,
                "ours": ours,
                "theirs": theirs,
            })
            plain = []
            i = j + 1
        else:
            plain.append(line)
            i += 1
    return segments, plain


def resolve(text, strategy):
    segs, tail = parse_conflicts(text)
    out = []
    for s in segs:
        out.extend(s["before"])
        if strategy == "ours":
            out.extend(s["ours"])
        elif strategy == "theirs":
            out.extend(s["theirs"])
        elif strategy == "union":
            out.extend(s["ours"] + s["theirs"])
        elif strategy == "manual":
            out.append("retries = 7")   # 人工决定的最终值
    out.extend(tail)
    return out


print("=== 1) 默认风格（merge.conflictStyle=merge）解析 ===")
segs, tail = parse_conflicts(BASE_STYLE)
for s in segs:
    print("  ours 标签   : %s" % s["ours_label"])
    print("  theirs 标签 : %s" % s["theirs_label"])
    print("  HEAD 段     : %s" % s["ours"])
    print("  feature 段  : %s" % s["theirs"])
    print("  base 段     : %s（默认风格没有，可用 merge.conflictStyle=diff3 打开）" % s["base"])
print("  冲突段数: %d" % len(segs))
print()

print("=== 2) diff3 风格（含 ||||||| 共同祖先段）解析 ===")
segs3, _ = parse_conflicts(DIFF3_STYLE)
for s in segs3:
    print("  base 段     : %s" % s["base"])
    print("  HEAD 段     : %s" % s["ours"])
    print("  feature 段  : %s" % s["theirs"])
print("  三方信息齐备: %s" % all(s["base"] for s in segs3))
print()

print("=== 3) 选择语义：git checkout --ours / --theirs / union / 人工解决 ===")
for strat in ("ours", "theirs", "union", "manual"):
    print("  %-7s -> %s" % (strat, resolve(BASE_STYLE, strat)))
print("  说明: union 把两侧行都留下（可能重复），--ours/--theirs 整段丢弃另一侧，都不等于『正确解决』")
print()

print("=== 4) rerere（reuse recorded resolution）回放 ===")
# 冲突指纹 = 冲突内容的稳定摘要（此处用 zlib.crc32 代替 Git 的冲突 id 散列）
import zlib


def conflict_id(s):
    key = "|".join(s["ours"]) + "||" + "|".join(s["theirs"])
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(key.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


recorded = {}
first = parse_conflicts(BASE_STYLE)[0][0]
cid = conflict_id(first)
recorded[cid] = ["retries = 7"]      # 第一次人工解决后由 rerere 记录
replay = parse_conflicts(BASE_STYLE)[0][0]
hit = recorded.get(conflict_id(replay))
print("  第一次解决后记录: id=%s -> %s" % (cid, recorded[cid]))
print("  再次遇到同一冲突时命中缓存: %s" % (hit is not None))
print("  自动套用的解决结果: %s" % hit)
print("  提示: rerere 需 git config rerere.enabled true，缓存位于 .git/rr-cache/")
